::: {#hero-heading}
<div class="h1">Hey, I'm happy you're here</div>

Thanks for stopping by! 

I work as a research assistant at the [NTID Research Center on Culture and Language](https://www.rit.edu/ntid/ccl) at the Rochester Institute of Technology. My research intrests inlcude utilizing data 
to improve educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students.

My current project with the NTID Research Center on Culture and Language aims to develop standardized assestment tools in American Sign Language to evaulate and screen for Alzheimer's disease and dementia in Deaf and Hard of Hearing Older Adults. Learn more about our work [here](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41642783/). 

Connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/emmamkane).
:::

### Featured Research Projects

- **Language and Cognition (LAC) Project (2024-Present)**  
  Contribute to the development and validation of neuropsychological assessment tools in American Sign Language designed to improve dementia and Alzheimer's disease screening for Deaf and Hard of Hearing older adults.

- **Access to Research Support for Deaf and Hard of Hearing Students (2026)**  
  Evaluated the accessibility of research-related resources, mentorship opportunities, and institutional support available to Deaf and Hard of Hearing students at Rochester Institute of Technology.

- **Reproductive Health Experiences of Deaf and Hard of Hearing Individuals (2023-2026)**  
  Examined barriers to reproductive health education and healthcare access and developed recommendations to improve health equity for Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities.
